lines: Hi! I'm Juniper, star reporter for the Old Oak Elementary newsletter! Can I ask you three questions? Question one: where are you from? Question two: why? Question three: do you like newts?
Juniper Okafor, Old Oak Elementary Gazette, covering the festival LIVE! Any comment on the apple bobbing?
My headline: 'Local Barrel Defeats Local Boy'. Ozzie got zero apples. Zero!
Hollow Herald, Winter Lights edition: 'Tree Lit, Town Delighted, Gus Seen Smiling.' Unconfirmed.
I'm interviewing everyone about their wishes. Strictly off the record. Mostly.
Kite Day report: wind, west-ish. Kites, many. Tangles so far: two.
Ozzie's kite has been stuck in the same tree for an hour. I'm calling it a story.
I'm timing the gaps between rockets for the paper. Nobody asked. Readers deserve facts.
I'm a detective dressed as a witch dressed as a detective. It's a disguise inside a disguise.
Clue: the Pickwicks give cupcakes. Second clue: GO NOW.
Weekends are for investigating. No homework, just clues.
Did you know Mr. Palmer goes for a walk at midnight? Every night? Suspicious.
I'm investigating why Gus is grumpy. So far: no clues. Just pie.
Recess! Ten minutes of freedom. I'm interviewing the hopscotch.

rotate: Breaking news: the big oak hummed at bedtime. My mum says it's the wind. The wind doesn't hum in tune!
Exclusive: Mr. Palmer was seen standing by the old oak at midnight. He said he was 'checking on it'. Checking on a TREE?
I want to interview Nina's family but Bruno says 'no comment' and skates off. Every time!
